components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Harbor Teal commit control for primary ops actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: #0f766e; color: #f4fffc; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0.42rem 0.85rem; font: 600 0.88rem/1.45 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #0d5f59; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action for batch bars and filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #1a2420; border: 1px solid #b8c4bc; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0.42rem 0.85rem; font: 600 0.88rem/1.45 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f8faf8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Signal Red control for irreversible actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #c24141; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0.42rem 0.85rem; font: 600 0.88rem/1.45 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c24141; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat ledger panel with fence border; no resting shadow.
components.html:
Expiring

3 hosts need attention
components.css: .ds-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff 94%, transparent); border: 1px solid #d5ddd7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; color: #1a2420; font: 400 15px/1.45 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 0.35rem; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: #5f6f67; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Panel input with Tide Mist focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; font-family: Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 550; color: #5f6f67; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d5ddd7; border-radius: 7px; color: #1a2420; padding: 0.48rem 0.65rem; font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #0f766e 55%, #d5ddd7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #d9efe9 80%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status chip; ok/warn/err variants tint border and fill.
components.html: unknown online stale offline
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.12rem 0.42rem; border-radius: 5px; font: 600 0.72rem/1.3 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; border: 1px solid #d5ddd7; background: #f8faf8; color: #5f6f67; } .ds-badge-ok { color: #1f8a5a; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #1f8a5a 35%, #d5ddd7); background: color-mix(in srgb, #1f8a5a 10%, #ffffff); } .ds-badge-warn { color: #b45309; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #b45309 35%, #d5ddd7); background: color-mix(in srgb, #b45309 10%, #ffffff); } .ds-badge-err { color: #c24141; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #c24141 35%, #d5ddd7); background: color-mix(in srgb, #c24141 10%, #ffffff); }

components.name: Shell Nav Link
components.description: Muted header nav with Tide Mist hover wash.
components.html: DashboardVPSMatrix
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.15rem; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { color: #5f6f67; font: 500 0.82rem/1.2 Manrope, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; padding: 0.28rem 0.48rem; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1a2420; background: color-mix(in srgb, #d9efe9 70%, transparent); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
VPSHub reads like an operator's fleet ledger: dense enough for tables and status matrices, calm enough for long sessions. Sage-tinted paper grounds the room; a single deep teal accent marks the next action. Brand moments use Source Serif 4; everything operational stays in Manrope so scan speed wins over decoration.

Atmosphere is tactile and confident without theatrics—controls feel pressable, borders do the structural work, and color is reserved for state (ok / warn / danger) and primary commits. Marketing flourish, purple-gradient chrome, and card-in-card nesting are out of character.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger density: tables, badges, and stat grids over illustration
One accent voice (teal) for commits and links
Flat surfaces; depth from border + tonal wash only
Serif brand mark, sans ops body, mono for codes/IDs
Sticky frosted header as the persistent shell

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Harbor Teal is the only brand accent. Status greens/ambers/reds never double as decorative chrome; they only encode state.

rules.name: The Brand-Only Serif Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 never appears in tables, badges, or form labels.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No resting box-shadow on .card. The only intentional glow is the 3px focus ring on fields.

dos: Do keep Harbor Teal rare—primary commits and links only.
Do encode health with Status Green / Amber Caution / Signal Red badges.
Do prefer borders and tonal washes over shadows.
Do use Source Serif 4 only for brand / auth title moments.
Do preserve bilingual label length; keep UI density scannable.
donts: Don't introduce purple/indigo gradient themes or glow stacks.
Don't nest cards inside cards for decoration.
Don't turn status colors into large decorative fills.
Don't put serif type in data tables or form labels.
